title: Alerting
lead: The part that earns the subscription: you hear about a bad change before your traffic does.

items.title: Channels
items.text: Email, Slack, Teams, a webhook, SMS or PagerDuty.

items.title: Connect and verify
items.text: Slack sign-in, a code, or a test ping, so we know it arrives.

items.title: What triggers an alert
items.text: robots.txt changed, a key path disallowed, Disallow: / on the whole site, AI bot access changed, sitemap removed, the file answering 4xx or 5xx, a competitor changing theirs.

items.title: Severity and routing
items.text: Critical goes to SMS and Slack; anything informational waits for the digest.

items.title: Quiet hours and escalation
items.text: Critical ignores quiet hours, and repeats until someone acknowledges it.

items.title: Send a test alert
items.text: A sample incident to every channel, so the first real one is not the first one.

blocks.text: A new account starts with email and critical only, so someone who skips this page is still covered.
Thresholds follow your sensitivity settings: in peak season the same change is worth waking someone for.
